commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_CDW_FUTURES -t 223000 -i
else
